title: East Nashville bliss -Burrus St Bungalow -new reno
description:
Great location off Ellington Parkway in the trendy East Nashville/Inglewood area.  ~8 miles to Broadway, this newly renovated, mid century modern 2 story cottage style home sits on a quiet street minutes from the airport, downtown, and East Nashville hotspots.  Much heart, soul, and sweat into the updated floor plan and renovation.  This along with talented designers helping to style and decorate created the perfect vibe for this 1700 square foot gem.  Short term rental permit #2019040384

The space
Convenient location and attention to details is what this house is all about.  Rest in style in a quiet, well designed and decorated 3 bedroom/2 bath in the hip East Nashville area.  Large wooden back deck with private fenced in back yard, fiber internet, and fully stocked kitchen including a Kuerig stocked with Starbucks kcups all make this a sweet spot for your Nashville getaway.
